answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bonded to one hardware attestation before it can trade, so the market becomes a haven for agents with something to lose. Each stake is tied to a single device key, an onyx seal that cannot be copied onto a second identity. An attacker wanting a reef of fake agents must fund a separate stake per fake, and misbehavior slashes the whole deposit, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes while honest agents risk nothing by behaving well.
